{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox NCAA team season |mode=Basketball |year=2019–20 |team=Little Rock Trojans |image=Little Rock Trojans.png |image_size=250 |conference=Sun Belt Conference |division= |short_conf=Sun Belt |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=21–10 |conf_record=15–5 |head_coach=[[Darrell Walker]] |hc_year=2nd |asst_coach1=Charles Baker |asst_coach2=Alfred Jordan |asst_coach3=Preston Laird |stadium=[[Jack Stephens Center]] |champion= Sun Belt regular season champions |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2019–20 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball standings}} [[File:Little Rock vs. UT Arlington men's basketball 2020 07 (in-game action).jpg|thumb|The Trojans in action against the [[2019–20 UT Arlington Mavericks men's basketball team|UT Arlington Mavericks]]]] The '''2019–20 Little Rock Trojans men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Arkansas at Little Rock]] in the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Trojans, were led by 2nd-year head coach [[Darrell Walker]], play their home games at the [[Jack Stephens Center]] in [[Little Rock, Arkansas]] as members of the [[Sun Belt Conference]]. They finished the season 21–10, 15–5 in Sun Belt play to win the Sun Belt regular season championship. They were the No. 1 seed in the [[2020 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball tournament|Sun Belt tournament]], however, the tournament was cancelled amid the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]]. Due to the Sun Belt Tournament cancellation, they were awarded the Sun Belt's automatic bid to the [[2020 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]]. However, the NCAA Tournament was also cancelled due to the same outbreak. ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 Little Rock Trojans men's basketball team|Trojans]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 10–21, 5–13 in Sun Belt play to finish in a tie for last place. They failed to qualify for the [[2019 Sun Belt Conference men's basketball tournament|Sun Belt tournament]].{{Cite
